name: zhud_mgr_enable_top_and_chat_stacks
description: HudUiMgr::EnableTopAndChatStacks clears and enables the global top-message and chat-message stacks.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HUD text-stack/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x413910 validates Clear plus virtual SetEnabled(1) on g_HudUiTopMessageStack followed by the same sequence for g_HudUiChatMessageStack.
The native smoke verifies both global stacks are enabled and all rows are cleared/hidden.
